issues.explanation: Chapter 56 says Zhou Yu was ambushed “in Jingzhou,” but Source Chapter 55 places the defeat near the Huangzhou boundary, after which Zhou Yu retreats by ship and later returns to柴桑. This mislocates the immediate handoff and conflicts with the source sequence.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace “在荆州中了诸葛亮的埋伏” with wording such as “在追赶刘备途中中了诸葛亮的埋伏” or “在黄州界附近中了诸葛亮的埋伏。”
